paragraphs: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. is a leading beverage company in North America that manufactures, markets, distributes, and sells hot and cold beverages and single serve brewing systems. We have a broad portfolio of iconic beverage brands, including Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, A&W, Peñafiel, GHOST, 7UP, Snapple, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, Clamato, The Original Donut Shop, and Core Hydration, as well as the Keurig brewing system. Our beverage brands are some of the most recognized beverage brands in North America, with significant consumer awareness levels and long histories that evoke strong emotional connections with consumers. We offer more than 125 owned, licensed, and partner brands, supported by powerful distribution capabilities.

KDP was created on July 9, 2018, through the combination of the business operations of Keurig, a leading producer of innovative single serve brewing systems and specialty coffee in the U.S. and Canada, and DPS, a company built over time through a series of strategic acquisitions that brought together iconic beverage brands in North America. Today, we trade on Nasdaq under the symbol KDP.

Our strategic framework starts with our purpose to Drink Well. Do Good. We aim to enhance the experience of every beverage occasion and to make a positive impact for people, communities, and the planet. Our vision is to be a total beverage leader, offering a beverage for every need, anytime, anywhere. We support our purpose and vision with five key strategies:

Champion consumer-obsessed brand building. We own a diverse portfolio of well-known beverage brands. Many of our brands enjoy high levels of consumer awareness, preference, and loyalty rooted in their rich heritage. This portfolio provides our customers with a wide variety of products to meet consumers' needs and provides us with a platform for growth and profitability. We drive growth in our business through investments in innovation, renovation, and marketing to support our portfolio of owned brands and partnerships with other leading beverage brands. We lead with deep consumer insights that inform our brand positioning and surface opportunities to address unmet needs. We have a robust innovation program, which is designed to meet consumers' changing flavor and beverage preferences and to grow our share of beverage occasions.

Shape our now and next beverage portfolio. We continually evaluate organic and inorganic investments that allow us to more fully meet evolving consumer preferences. Where appropriate, we leverage and extend our existing brands. We also cultivate strong relationships with leading beverage brands that enable us to form long-term, capital-efficient partnerships. In certain cases, we may add complementary brands to our owned portfolio through acquisitions. This flexible approach allows us to optimally address whitespace growth opportunities in our portfolio.

Amplify our route-to-market advantage. In our DSD network, we have strategically located distribution capabilities that enable us to better align our operations with our customers and sales channels, ensure our products are available to meet consumer demand, reduce transportation costs, and have greater control over the timing and coordination of new product launches. We actively manage transportation of our products using our fleet (owned and leased) of approximately 8,100 vehicles in the U.S. and 2,200 in Mexico, as well as third-party logistics providers.

With our Keurig.com website, we have a leading direct-to-consumer e-commerce platform which provides us insights and expertise in the e-commerce channel. We continually invest in digital tools and capabilities as part of our route-to-market strategy, and as one element of a holistic digital transformation across KDP.

Generate fuel for growth. We focus on critical transformational investments that drive continuous productivity and network optimization. We also maintain emphasis on lean overheads to drive operating leverage and fund investments in our growth opportunities.

Dynamically allocate capital. Our highly efficient business model, focused on an optimized capital structure, gives us optionality to invest internally and pursue investments, partnerships, acquisitions, or other opportunities to continue to drive growth and create value, while remaining committed to a strong balance sheet with investment grade ratings.
PROPOSED JDE PEET'S ACQUISITION AND SUBSEQUENT SEPARATION

On August 24, 2025, we entered into an agreement to acquire JDE Peet's, a global pure-play coffee company with a portfolio of leading brands including Jacobs, L'OR, and Peet's. The JDE Peet's Acquisition is expected to occur early in the second quarter of 2026 and is subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the closing conditions, including the acceptance of the offer by the shareholders of JDE Peet's. We've also entered into a series of transactions to fund the JDE Peet's Acquisition. Refer to Note 3 of the Notes to our Consolidated Financial Statements for additional information on the JDE Peet's Acquisition and related transactions.

On August 25, 2025, we announced our intention to separate our beverage and coffee portfolios into two independent, publicly traded companies, which will allow for more tailored growth strategies, operating models, and approaches to capital allocation. The Separation is expected to occur subsequent to the closure of the JDE Peet's Acquisition.
We are a leading integrated brand owner, manufacturer, and distributor of beverages in the U.S., Canada, Mexico, the Caribbean, and other international markets.

As of December 31, 2025, our operating structure consists of three operating and reportable segments: U.S. Refreshment Beverages, U.S. Coffee, and International. Segment financial data, including financial information about foreign and domestic operations, is included in Note 9 of the Notes to our Consolidated Financial Statements.

paragraphs: This section of this Annual Report on Form 10-K generally discusses the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 and year-over-year comparisons between the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024. Discussions of the periods prior to the year ended December 31, 2024 that are not included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K are found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024 and the discussion therein for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023 is incorporated by reference into this Annual Report.

This Annual Report on Form 10-K contains the names of some of our owned or licensed trademarks, trade names and service marks, which we refer to as our brands. All of the product names included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K are either our registered trademarks or those of our licensors.

KDP is a leading beverage company in North America that manufactures, markets, distributes, and sells hot and cold beverages and single serve brewing systems. We have a broad portfolio of iconic beverage brands, including Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, A&W, Peñafiel, GHOST, 7UP, Snapple, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, Clamato, The Original Donut Shop, and Core Hydration, as well as the Keurig brewing system. Our beverage brands are some of the most recognized beverage brands in North America, with significant consumer awareness levels and long histories that evoke strong emotional connections with consumers. We offer more than 125 owned, licensed, and partner brands, supported by powerful distribution capabilities.
Our operating and reportable segments are as follows:

•The U.S. Refreshment Beverages segment reflects sales in the U.S. from the manufacture and distribution of branded concentrates, syrups, finished beverages, and other consumables, including the sales of our own brands and third-party brands, to third-party bottlers, distributors, and retailers.

•The U.S. Coffee segment reflects sales in the U.S. from the manufacture and distribution of finished goods relating to our K-Cup pods, single serve brewers, and other coffee products to partners, retailers, and directly to consumers through our Keurig.com website.
•The International segment reflects sales in international markets, including the following:

◦Sales in Canada, Mexico, the Caribbean, and other international markets from the manufacture and distribution of branded concentrates, syrup, and finished beverages, including sales of our own brands and third-party brands, to third-party bottlers, distributors, and retailers.
◦Sales in Canada from the manufacture and distribution of finished goods relating to our single serve brewers, K-Cup pods, and other coffee products.
In evaluating our performance, we use different volume measures for LRB and for K-Cup pods and appliances.
For LRB, we measure our sales volume in 288 fluid ounce equivalent cases.

•For beverage concentrates, we measure our sales volume as concentrate case sales for concentrates sold by us to our bottlers and distributors. A concentrate case is the amount of concentrate needed to make one case of 288 fluid ounces of finished beverage, the equivalent of 24 twelve-ounce servings. It does not include any other component of the finished beverage other than concentrate.

•For packaged beverages, we measure volume as case sales to customers. A case sale represents a unit of measurement equal to 288 fluid ounces of packaged beverage sold by us. Case sales include both our owned brands and certain brands licensed to and/or distributed by us.
For our K-Cup pods and appliances, we measure our sales volume as the number of appliances and the number of individual K-Cup pods sold to our customers.

headings: 產品創新與新夥伴關係
paragraphs: Keurig Dr Pepper Inc. 為北美地區領先的飲料公司，從事熱飲與冷飲飲料及單次使用釀造系統的製造、行銷、配送與銷售。我們擁有廣泛的知名飲料品牌組合，包括 Dr Pepper、Canada Dry、Mott's、A&W、Peñafiel、GHOST、7UP、Snapple、Green Mountain Coffee Roasters、Clamato、The Original Donut Shop、Core Hydration，以及 Keurig 釀造系統。我們的飲料品牌是北美地區最受認知的飲料品牌之一，具有高消費者認知度與悠久的歷史，能激發消費者強烈的情感連結。我們提供超過 125 種自有、授權及合作品牌，並擁有強大的配送能力作為支援。
KDP 於 2018 年 7 月 9 日成立，為 Keurig 與 DPS 組合後的企業，Keurig 為美國與加拿大創新單次使用釀造系統與特調咖啡的領先製造商，DPS 則是透過一系列戰略收購逐步建立的公司，整合了北美地區的知名飲料品牌。目前，我們在納斯達克上市，股票代碼為 KDP。
我們的戰略架構以我們的宗旨「Drink Well. Do Good.」為起點。我們旨在提升每一飲料場合的體驗，並對人們、社區與地球產生正面影響。我們的願景是成為總體飲料領導者，提供符合每種需求的飲料，隨時隨地皆可取得。我們透過五大關鍵戰略來支持我們的宗旨與願景：

倡導以消費者為中心的品牌建設。我們擁有廣泛且知名的飲料品牌組合。許多品牌擁有高消費者認知度、偏好與忠誠度，這源自於其深厚的歷史背景。此組合為我們的客戶提供多樣化的產品選擇，以滿足消費者的需求，並為我們提供成長與獲利的平台。我們透過對創新、翻新與行銷的投資，來推動業務成長，以支援我們的自有品牌組合與與其他領先飲料品牌的合作。我們以深入的消費者洞察為導向，以塑造品牌定位並發現未被滿足的需求機會。我們擁有強大的創新計畫，旨在符合消費者變動的風味與飲料偏好，並提高我們在飲料場合的市佔率。
塑造我們現在與未來的飲料組合。我們持續評估內生與外生投資，以更完整地滿足消費者偏好的演變。在適當的情況下，我們會運用並延展我們現有的品牌。我們也培養與領先飲料品牌的強大關係，以建立長遠、資本效率高的合作夥伴關係。在某些情況下，我們可能透過收購將補充性的品牌加入我們的自有組合。這種靈活的策略使我們能最佳化地應對組閤中的空白成長機會。
強化我們的通路優勢。在我們的 DSD 網路中，我們擁有戰略性設置的配送能力，使我們能更好地與客戶與銷售通路對齊，確保產品能即時應對消費者需求，降低運輸成本，並對新產品發佈的時機與協調擁有更大控制力。我們積極管理產品的運輸，使用約 8,100 輛自有與租賃車輛在美國，以及 2,200 輛在墨西哥，以及第三方物流供應商。
透過我們的 Keurig.com 網站，我們擁有領先的直接對消費者電子商務平台，提供我們在電子商務通路的洞察與專業知識。我們持續投資於數位工具與能力，作為我們通路策略的一部分，並作為 KDP 整體數位轉型的一環。
創造成長動力。我們專注於關鍵的轉型投資，以推動持續的生產力與網路優化。我們也持續強調精簡的營運費用，以提升營運槓桿效益，並資助我們成長機會的投資。
動態配置資本。我們高度高效的商業模式，專注於最佳化的資本結構，使我們有彈性可以內部投資並追求投資、合作夥伴關係、收購或其他機會，以持續推動成長並創造價值，同時維持對強健資產負債表的承諾，並保持投資等級的信用評級。
擬議的 JDE PEET'S 收購及隨後的分拆

於 2025 年 8 月 24 日，我們與 JDE Peet's 籤訂協議，擬收購 JDE Peet's，一家全球純咖啡公司，旗下擁有 Jacobs、L'OR 與 Peet's 等領導品牌。JDE Peet's 收購預計於 2026 年第二季初期完成，並需符合關閉條件或取得豁免，包括 JDE Peet's 股東接受要約。我們也已簽訂一系列交易以籌措 JDE Peet's 收購資金。有關 JDE Peet's 收購及相關交易的更多資訊，請參閱我們合併財務報表附註的第 3 節。
於 2025 年 8 月 25 日，我們宣佈有意將飲料與咖啡產品組合分拆為兩家獨立且公開上市的公司，這將允許更針對性的成長策略、營運模式及資本配置方式。分拆預計在 JDE Peet's 收購完成後進行。
我們是美國、加拿大、墨西哥、加勒比海地區及其他國際市場中，領先的整合型品牌擁有者、製造商與分銷商。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們的營運結構包含三個營運及應報告分部：美國飲料、美國咖啡與國際。分部財務資料，包括關於海外與國內營運的財務資訊，請參閱我們合併財務報表附註的第 9 節。

paragraphs: 本年度報表（Form 10-K）之此節段落一般討論截至2025年12月31日止之會計年度，以及2025年與2024年之間之年對年比較。有關截至2024年12月31日止之前之期間之討論，未包含於本年度報表（Form 10-K）中者，請參閱我們2024年12月31日止年度報表（Form 10-K）之第二部分，第7項「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」，以及該部分中2024年12月31日止年度與2023年12月31日止年度之比較內容，已納入本年度報表。
本年度報表（Form 10-K）包含一些我們擁有或授權之商標、商名及服務標誌之名稱，我們稱之為我們的品牌。本年度報表（Form 10-K）中所包含之所有產品名稱，皆為我們之註冊商標或我們之授權方之商標。

KDP為北美地區領先之飲料公司，從事熱飲與冷飲飲料以及單次使用釀造系統之製造、行銷、配送與銷售。我們擁有廣泛之知名飲料品牌組合，包括Dr Pepper、Canada Dry、Mott's、A&W、Peñafiel、GHOST、7UP、Snapple、Green Mountain Coffee Roasters、Clamato、The Original Donut Shop、Core Hydration，以及Keurig釀造系統。我們之飲料品牌為北美地區最受認知之飲料品牌之一，具有顯著之消費者認知度與悠久歷史，能喚起消費者強烈之情感連結。我們提供超過125種自有、授權及合作品牌，並擁有強大之配送能力。
本公司之營運及應報告分部如下：
•美國飲料分部反映美國市場銷售情形，來自品牌濃縮液、糖漿、成品飲料及其他消耗品之製造與配送，包括本公司品牌與第三方品牌之銷售至第三方灌裝商、經銷商與零售商。
•美國咖啡分部反映美國市場銷售情形，來自K-Cup杯、單次使用釀造機及其它咖啡產品之製造與配送至合作夥伴、零售商及直接至消費者透過本公司Keurig.com網站。
•國際分部反映國際市場銷售情形，包括以下內容：
◦加拿大、墨西哥、加勒比地區及其他國際市場之銷售情形，來自品牌濃縮液、糖漿及成品飲料之製造與配送，包括本公司品牌與第三方品牌之銷售至第三方灌裝商、經銷商與零售商。
◦加拿大銷售額來自於我們單次沖泡咖啡機、K-Cup pods 以及其它咖啡產品的製造與分銷。
在評估我們的表現時，我們針對LRB與K-Cup pods及相關設備使用不同的銷售量衡量方式。
對於LRB，我們以288流動盎司等效的箱數來衡量銷售量。
•對於飲料濃縮液，我們以濃縮液箱數銷售來衡量銷售量。濃縮液箱數是指我們銷售給灌裝商與分銷商的濃縮液數量，用以製作出一箱288流動盎司的成品飲料，相當於24盒十二盎司的飲料份量。此數量不包含成品飲料除濃縮液以外的任何零組件。
•對於包裝飲料，我們以銷售至客戶的箱數來衡量銷售量。一箱銷售代表288流動盎司的包裝飲料銷售數量。箱數銷售包含我們自有品牌以及部分由我們授權及/或分銷的品牌。
對於我們的K-Cup pods及相關設備，我們以銷售至客戶的設備數量與個別K-Cup pods數量來衡量銷售量。

headings: 本公司製造與分銷業務或供應鏈中斷，包括投入成本增加，可能不利於本公司財務狀況或營運成果。
本公司所處產業為高度競爭性，若無法有效競爭，可能對本公司業務造成負面影響。
本公司可能無法有效回應消費者偏好與購物行為的變化，此情形可能影響本公司財務結果。
對本公司產品安全性、品質或健康影響的擔憂，可能對本公司業務造成負面影響。
本公司聲譽或品牌形象受損，可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
若本公司未能成功管理對新業務或品牌之收購及投資，營運成果可能受到負面影響。
未能實現生產力方案的效益或成功管理其潛在負面後果，可能對本公司財務表現造成不利影響。
本公司設施與營運可能需要大量投資與升級，而這些投資可能無法達到預期的財務效益。
我們依賴關鍵資訊系統，且我們使用資訊科技會使我們面臨業務中斷的風險，這可能會對我們造成不利影響。
我們的智慧財產權權利可能被侵權，或我們可能侵權他人的智慧財產權，且有關授權智慧財產權的不利事件可能會損害我們的業務。
未能吸引、留住、培訓及激勵高素質且多元化的員工，或未能有效管理員工結構的變化，可能會對我們的營運造成重大影響。
我們可能無法在滿意的條件下續約集體談判協議，或我們可能面臨工會活動，包括新工會組織、勞資爭議或停工事件。
我們未來員工福利成本的增加可能會降低我們的利潤率。
我們與供應商協商以優化我們的條款與條件，包括付款條件，且我們與供應商付款條件的縮短可能會對我們的流動性造成不利影響。
我們的商譽及其他無限期存續的無形資產價值減損，可能會對我們的財務報表造成重大不利影響。
我們依賴第三方瓶裝與分銷公司來執行我們業務的大部分部分。
零售業態的變動或對任何主要客戶的銷售變動，可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
未能維持與品牌擁有者及自有品牌之間的戰略關係，可能對本公司未來成長與業務造成不利影響，甚至導致這些協議終止。
權益法投資是獨立於本公司管理的，其利益可能與本公司不同。其決策可能影響本公司的財務表現。
本公司第三方商業夥伴及服務提供者使用資訊科技，可能使本公司面臨業務中斷或其他負面影響，可能對本公司造成不利影響。
本公司依賴有限數量的供應商及製造商來生產啤酒，並依賴有限數量的訂單履行公司來處理啤酒、飲料濃縮液及糖漿。
不景氣的總體經濟與地緣政治條件可能對本公司財務結果造成負面影響。
美國及國際法規可能對本公司業務造成不利影響。
訴訟或法律程序可能使本公司面臨重大負債，並損害本公司聲譽。
對於塑膠或其他包裝材料之使用或處置所產生之關注度增加，可能對本公司之業務及財務表現造成負面影響。
重大之附加標籤或警告要求，或對本公司產品之行銷或銷售所設限製，可能抑制受影響產品之銷售。
本公司使用資訊科技及第三方服務提供者，使本公司面臨網路安全 breaches 及其他業務中斷之風險，可能對本公司造成負面影響。
